title: Logo reveal with intro and outro
description: The logo builds from its parts (stem, then accent stroke, then pixels), then the wordmark and tagline appear. Three versions: Sting, Intro and Outro, each in 16:9 and 9:16.
next: cd into the project folder, run npm ci once, edit content.json, then: npm run studio, or: python scripts/studio.py render --project {name} --comp Logo-Intro-16x9
